svg.title: Two jobs become one event DAG
svg.desc: Two jobs; job expansion, tray assignment and AGV assignment build the event DAG; the last steps execute it.
svg.metadata: ["The scheduler receives two jobs. Job A: retrieve the vehicle on tray T17 at bay B21. Job B: clean the garage by moving tray T27 off waypoint W27.", "Job expansion: each job becomes events with must-happen-before edges. Some details are still open: where tray T21 goes when it leaves the bay.", "Tray assignment fills the open destination (tray T21 to stall P23) and adds an event for tray T15, which stands on the route of tray T17.", "AGV assignment: AGV-1 takes job A's three tray moves, in order; AGV-2 takes job B. The event DAG is complete and goes to motion planning.", "Execution: AGV-1 moves tray T15 to stall P19 while AGV-2 moves tray T27 to stall P24. The two jobs run in parallel.", "Bay B21 is in retrieve mode; AGV-1 takes the empty tray T21 out of the bay to stall P23.", "AGV-1 brings tray T17 into bay B21 and the bay hands the vehicle over. Both jobs are complete."]
